title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-03-20
lineage: SBD > MR > PCM > ZA2 > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording that’s generally good but has occasional low‑quality spots, showcasing a scorching second electric set highlighted by Good Lovin', Viola Lee, High Times and an epic We Bid You Goodnight.
ai_review.review: The tape captures the energy of the Capitol Theater show with mostly clear soundboard quality, though a few sections dip into muddy, low‑level audio. Musically the concert is praised for a bang‑starting Casey Jones, a stellar China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider segue and a second set that smokes on Good Lovin'/Not Fade Away/drums, Viola Lee Blues, High Times, Love Light and a long We Bid You Goodnight.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the performance (average 4‑star sentiment) while noting variable recording quality; combined weighting yields a solid but not outstanding rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall clear and lively soundboard capture, but several passages are described as low‑quality or muddy, giving the tape an uneven listening experience.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: The show opens strong and builds into a powerful second electric set; acoustic interludes are noted but the real highlight is the triple‑decker Good Lovin'/NFA/drums sequence followed by a string of high‑energy numbers.
